compiled_state.description:
## Observation
AGENTS.md (Bound background helpers at spawn) makes it mandatory that no process an agent starts may reach PPID 1. rebar itself, on an ordinary ticket write or close, starts a compaction sweep through rebar._proc.spawn_detached (src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py _spawn_detached_sweep), which deliberately outlives the command and is reparented to PID 1. Three agent sessions on 2026-11-03 PST (closes of westbound-chivalric-pinemarten and overweak-deviant-shelduck, and a ticket write in the latter) reported this worker at PPID 1 and could not comply with the rule without killing rebar's own worker mid-sweep under the store lock. docs/orphaned-processes.md already says PPID 1 is a signal, not proof of a defect, but AGENTS.md has no carve-out and docs/orphaned-processes.md does not name rebar's detached workers.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AGENTS.md and docs/orphaned-processes.md agree on whether rebar's own detached workers (compaction sweep, and any other spawn_detached caller) are exempt from the PPID 1 rule, and name how an agent identifies them (command line / lock holder) so it does not kill one mid-sweep.
- [ ] scripts/check_orphaned_load.py either recognises rebar's detached workers or its documentation says how to tell them apart.
compiled_state.title: AGENTS.md forbids PPID 1, but rebar detaches its own sweep
